rationale: Add Cargo dependency caching via actions/cache@v4 to all Rust jobs. The repository has a committed Cargo.lock (pinned dependencies) and runs CI on every push/PR to main, so dependency downloads are repeated on every run and no cache currently exists. This matches P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads): cache the dependency download state (~/.cargo/registry, ~/.cargo/git) plus the build target directory, keyed on runner OS, toolchain/target, and Cargo.lock hash, while keeping every installation and test step unchanged. Cache keys are scoped per job/matrix entry to avoid cross-contamination, and restore-keys provide fallback hits. All build and test coverage is preserved; no permissions are weakened, no secrets or deployment actions are added, and no new network access beyond GitHub's built-in cache service is introduced.
